blocks.title: Diffraction
blocks.text: Roshni ka rukawaton (obstacles) ke kinaron se mur jana aur rukawat ke geometrical saye (shadow) ke andar tak phail jana diffraction kehlata hai.

Agar interference ke tajurbe mein slits ki tadaad barha di jaye (aur saath wali slits ka faasla wahi rakha jaye) to maxima (roshan lakeerein) usi jagah rehte hain, lekin do slits ke muqable mein zyada se zyada patle (narrow) hote jate hain. Yeh maxima itne patle hain ke in ka angle, aur us se wavelength, bohat durusti (precision) se napi ja sakti hai. Is asar ke bohat se ahem istemal hain.

Bohat si parallel slits ki aisi tarteeb jin ke markazon (centres) ka darmiyani faasla d barabar ho, diffraction grating kehlati hai. Pehli grating Fraunhofer ne bareek taron (fine wires) se banayi thi. Gratings diamond ki nok se sheeshe ya dhaat ki satah par barabar faasle wali bohat si lakeerein (grooves) khurach kar banayi ja sakti hain, ya kaghaz par kaali aur safed dhaariyon ke naqshe ko photographic tareeqe se chhota kar ke. Grating mein slits ko aksar rulings ya lines bhi kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab slit ki chaurai (width) ko bhi d likhti hai, jo slits ke markazon ke faasle ka symbol hai. Har slit ki chaurai alag aur chhoti miqdar hai (aksar a likhte hain); d do saath wali slits ke markazon ka faasla hai.

blocks.alt: Khari grating jis mein d faasle par paanch slits hain. Baen se mutawazi gulabi shuaein aati hain; har slit se shua seedhi (dashed) simt se theta zawiye par neeche nikalti hai. Har slit par shua ka chhota mota hissa, jo neeche wali slit se nuqta-daar amood kaat-ta hai, delta L hai; oopar delta L = d sin theta likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.16: Diffraction grating (kitab ki Figure 15.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Laser diffraction grating se p faasle par screen par roshni dalta hai. Paanch gulabi lakeerein screen tak phailti hain, oopar se neeche n = 2, 1, 0, 1, 2; pehle aur doosre order ke zawiye theta1 aur theta2 dikhaye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.17: Naqshe ke orders (kitab ki Figure 15.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 15.17 mein orders 'a = 2, a = 1, a = 0' chhape hain aur dono zawiyon par θ₁ hai. Durust nishan n hai (d sin θ = nλ), aur doosre order ka zawiya θ₂ hai, jo θ₁ se bara hai. Khaake mein yahi likha hai.

Fig. 15.16 transmission grating ka cross section (aar paar kata hua manzar) hai; slits page ki satah ke perpendicular hain, aur slits se guzarne wali roshni interference pattern banati hai. Diagram mein sirf paanch slits hain; asal grating mein kai hazar ho sakti hain. Do saath wali slits ke markazon ka faasla d grating spacing kehlata hai. Aik plane monochromatic lehar baen taraf se grating par seedhi (normal) parti hai. Hum far-field (Fraunhofer) halaat farz karte hain, yani screen itni door hai ke grating se nikal kar screen ke kisi aik point ki taraf jane wali tamam shuaein parallel samjhi ja sakti hain.

Bohat si slits ke principal maxima (bare roshan nishan) unhi simton mein bante hain jin mein do slits wale pattern ke bante hain. Yeh woh simtein hain jin mein saath wali slits ka path difference wavelength ka poora adad guna ho. Is liye maxima ki jagah phir wahi formula deta hai:

blocks.text_alt: d sin θ = nλ where n = 0, ±1, ±2, ±3 …   (15.7)

blocks.text: Jab saikron ya hazaron slits wali grating par monochromatic roshni ki parallel shuaein dali jayen to pattern bohat tez (sharp) lakeeron ka silsila hota hai, jin ke angles is formula se milte hain. n = ±1 wali lakeerein first-order lines, n = ±2 wali second-order lines, waghaira kehlati hain. Agar grating par safed roshni dali jaye jis mein lagatar saari wavelengths hon, to n ki har qeemat par pattern mein aik poora (continuous) spectrum banta hai. Har wavelength ka angle equation (15.7) se milta hai: kisi aik n ke liye lambi wavelengths (spectrum ka surkh sira) zyada angle par hoti hain (yani seedhi simt se zyada murti hain), aur chhoti wavelengths (neela sira) kam angle par.

Equation (15.7) se pata chalta hai ke maxima ke angles ka sine λ/d ke proportional hai. Numayan (kaafi) murne ke liye grating spacing d wavelength λ ke darje (order of magnitude) ki honi chahiye. Nazar aane wali roshni (λ = 400 se 700 nm) ki gratings mein aam taur par taqreeban 1000 slits fi millimetre hoti hain; d fi ikai lambai slits ki tadaad ka ulat (reciprocal) hai, is liye d taqreeban 1000 nm ke darje ka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paragraph mein wavelength ka symbol do jagah 'l' chhapti hai ('wavelength l' aur '(l from 400 to 700 nm)'); sahi symbol λ hai.
Hal shuda misal (izafi, kitab ki nahi)

blocks.title: Izafi misal
blocks.problem: Aik grating mein 500 lines fi millimetre hain. 600 nm wavelength ki roshni us par seedhi (normal) parti hai. First-order maximum ka angle aur sab se oonchi mumkin order maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: 500 lines fi mm, λ = 600 nm = 600 × 10⁻⁹ m, n = 1.
Sab se oonchi order: sin θ 1 se zyada nahi ho sakta, is liye n ≤ d/λ = 3.3; n = 3 par sin θ = 0.90.
blocks.answer: θ₁ = 17.5°; sab se oonchi order n = 3

blocks.prompt: Diffraction grating mein zyada slits aur qareeb qareeb slits ke kya faide hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada slits maxima ko bohat patla aur roshan banati hain, is liye wavelength durusti se napi ja sakti hai aur qareebi wavelengths alag nazar aati hain. Qareeb slits (chhota d) orders ko bare angles tak phailati hain, yani spectrum zyada phailta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi grating par surkh roshni ki jagah neeli roshni dalein to pattern kaise badlega?
blocks.explanation: Neeli roshni ki wavelength chhoti hai, is liye har order ke liye sin θ = nλ/d kam hota hai: lakeerein markazi maximum ke qareeb aa jati hain, aur zyada orders mumkin hote hain.

items: Diffraction: roshni ka rukawat ke kinaron se mur kar saye mein phailna.
Grating: barabar faasle d wali bohat si slits; maxima patle aur tez.
d sin θ = nλ (15.7); n = ±1 first order, n = ±2 second order.
Safed roshni: har order aik spectrum, surkh zyada angle par; visible light ke liye d taqreeban 1000 nm.
